svg.aria-label: Feeling or thought? Show it with your hand! Two illustrated students in two cards. Left card, Hand on heart = FEELING: a nervous girl with worried eyebrows, a wavy mouth and a sweat drop presses her hand flat on her chest, where a glowing heart shines. Her speech bubble says “I’m nervous about the presentation.” with the word nervous highlighted; the note says a real feeling word (adjective). Right card, Hand on head = THOUGHT: a thinking boy with one raised eyebrow looks up and rests his hand on the top of his head while thought bubbles rise above him. His speech bubble says “I feel like you are not listening to me.” with feel like highlighted; the note says feel + like / that / as if / you.
svg.title: Feeling or thought
svg.text: Feeling or thought? Show it with your hand!
